name: Pill Nav
rationale: Clean-room implementation from the one-line effect description only; a rounded link track with a springy sliding pill indicator that collapses to a dropdown on narrow hosts, rebuilt with CSS transitions instead of GSAP so it ships dependency-free.

radius.description: Corner radius of the track, pills and indicator.

accentText.description: Link text colour while the indicator sits under it.

collapseBelow.description: Collapse behind the menu button when the host is narrower than this, in px (0 never collapses).

followHover.description: Move the indicator to the hovered or focused link.

trackActive.description: Make a clicked link the current one (aria-current="page").

closeOnOutside.description: Close the collapsed menu when the pointer goes down outside the navigation.

a11y: Links stay native <a> elements in a <ul> inside a <nav>; the current one carries aria-current="page" and the sliding pill is an aria-hidden decoration.
Keyboard focus moves the pill exactly as hover does, and every link and the menu button keep a visible :focus-visible ring.

When collapsed, the menu button is a native <button> with aria-expanded and aria-controls; Esc closes the menu and returns focus to it, and the closed list is visibility:hidden so its links leave the tab order.
The list only collapses when a menu button exists to reopen it, and forced-colors mode paints the pill in Highlight.
